data.name: Infernal Claws
data.description: A fiendflesh shifter's claws are infused with the unholy power of the evil Outer Planes. A fiendflesh shifter's claws are treated as evil weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. This ability otherwise functions as the shifter claws class feature. This alters shifter claws.
